briefing.headline: LUXE spikes 5.1% while mega‑cap tech drags lower
briefing.summary: Overnight the core mega‑cap tech group and major indices slipped, with nine of ten core tickers posting declines and only AAPL posting a modest gain. The sell‑off was broad, dragging AMD, NVDA, TSLA, AMZN, QQQ, GOOGL, META, SPY and MSFT lower. A few outliers bucked the trend – LUXE jumped 5.1% and MSTZ rose 4.9%, while leveraged semiconductor ETF SOXL fell 5.5%. Overall breadth was negative, signaling a risk‑off tone into the US open.
